title: Gatekeeper Quicklaunch — modular entry strips and interactive step rail
creator: Priya Nair
deliverables: Hero collage (desktop + mobile) — static PNG & SVG
Interactive step rail prototype — Figma interactive prototype
Annotated screenshot pack for docs (16:9 + mobile)
Motion spec (Lottie + framer notes) and 2s/6s variants
Screenshot pipeline checklist and QA runbook
success_metrics: Increase quickstart completion rate by 12% within 4 weeks of release
Maintain WCAG AA color contrast in hero and step rail components
design_notes: Primary goal: reduce cognitive overhead — surface the smallest set of progressive steps instead of full checklist
Modular strips should be composable for different product personas (API-first vs SDK users)
Hero collage blends a single emphasized screenshot with micro-illustration to communicate speed + predictability
Step rail must be keyboard accessible: focus state, screenreader labels, and linear tab order
Motion rules: subtle entrance (0.18s ease-out) and confirmation pulse on completion; provide reduced-motion alternatives
Color decisions must align to brand tokens; avoid gradient overlays that break tokenization for theming
